title: Garáž
description:
The Garage is the smallest stage of the Pohoda festival, which symbolizes the beginnings of the bands. Every year after the festival, in cooperation with Trenčín 2026, it moves to the city of Trenčín and for a few weeks it turns into a cultural space with its own programme.

The Garage's ambition is not only to enrich the cultural offer in Trenčín. Garage wants to create opportunities for presentation, education and networking for the upcoming generation of Slovak musicians, multidisciplinary artists and professionals in the field of cultural and creative industries.
